whisper_dir.description: Directory where Whisper database files are stored.

whisper_user.description: System user account under which Carbon processes run (for file permissions).

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging (debug, info, warning, error, critical).

log_file.description: Path to the Carbon log file.

use_systick.description: Whether to use syslog instead of file logging.

max_creates_per_minute.description: Maximum Whisper file creation rate per minute per process.

max_updates_per_second.description: Maximum total metric update rate across all daemons.

max_updates_queue_size.description: Maximum number of pending updates queued before dropping data.

max_updates_buffer_size.description: Maximum buffer size (bytes) for incoming updates (pickle).

host.description: Hostname or IP of the backend instance.

port.description: Port number (e.g., 2004 for line, 2003 for pickle).

consistent_hashing.description: Use consistent hashing to route metrics (requires 'consistent' method).

hash_key.description: Field used as key for hashing: 'metric' (metric name) or 'source' (remote IP).

max_queue_size.description: Maximum number of metrics in the aggregator queue.

cache.description: Cache daemon configuration (required for basic operation).

line_receiver_port.description: Port to listen for plaintext line protocol metrics (e.g., 'metric value timestamp\n').

pickle_receiver_port.description: Port to listen for pickled metrics (used by python-carbon clients).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent TCP connections.

pickle_receiver_buffer_size.description: Maximum size of incoming pickle payload in bytes.

enable_logging.description: Enable pickle packet logging for debugging.

max_updates_per_second.description: Maximum metric update rate allowed per second (drops excess).

max_creates_per_minute.description: Maximum number of new Whisper files created per minute.

max_updates_queue_size.description: Maximum pending update operations before dropping metrics.

enable_udp_listener.description: Enable listening on UDP for line protocol metrics (not recommended for high volume).

udp_receiver_port.description: UDP port for plaintext line protocol metrics.
